verdict.rationale: Browserbase is an API platform where agents authenticate with API keys, so issuing scoped credentials is a fair axis. The evidence never documents scoped, restricted or least-privilege keys; the llms.txt probe instead describes a single API key giving the agent everything it needs. Webhooks, the SDK, the MCP server and the CLI are other capabilities and do not count toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
